name: claude-skills
description: Claude Code mods by ataege: a calm checklist view, a colored status bar, model routing for agents, a menu for them all and a prompt upgrader.

plugins.name: clean-view
plugins.description: Clean View hides tool calls and shows a calm checklist above the prompt; Agent Dock splits each request across a team of helpers you pick and shows each one live.

plugins.name: status-bar
plugins.description: One colored line under the prompt: plan, model, effort, context, 7-day and 5-hour limits, and running agents by model and effort.

plugins.name: model-routing
plugins.description: Routes every delegated agent to the cheapest model tier that can do the job well, at an explicit effort, with spawn limits and a routing guide Claude always sees.

plugins.name: mods-menu
plugins.description: A ☰ Mods button beside the Clean View toggle that opens a small menu of your mods and their controls: Clean View on or off, the Agent Dock and its Team Size, and more.

plugins.name: prompt-upgrade
plugins.description: Turns a rough prompt into a great one before it is sent: up to three quick questions, a rewrite, and the original and the upgrade side by side. Nothing runs until you press Run.
